messages.共鳴数に応じた充電を溜めて一気に消費して火力に変える、嫉妬編成と充電人格向けの低: A low-cost E.G.O for Envy teams and Charge Identities that builds Charge based on Resonance and spends it all at once for damage.
messages.充電の獲得と消費: 攻撃前に(最大共鳴数+1)だけ充電回数が増え(最大7)、続け: **Gaining and spending Charge**: Before attacking, Charge Count increases by (highest Resonance + 1), up to 7, then it spends up to 15, gaining damage per point spent.
messages.束縛と火傷: 的中時に火傷を付与し、住民登録マイクロチップと、次のターンの束縛1: **Bind and Burn**: On hit, inflicts Burn, Resident Reg. Microchip, and 1 Bind next turn. Enemies with the Microchip or Bind receive more Burn Count.
messages.パッシブ「転入届の処理」: 最大共鳴数が3以上なら、メインターゲットへ、スキル的: **Passive — Processing Transfer Reg**: If the highest Resonance is 3 or more, skill hits inflict 1 Bind next turn on the main target (once per turn).
messages.低コスト: 必要資源は憤怒1・嫉妬5、精神消耗は20。: **Low cost**: Requires 1 Wrath and 5 Envy, with a Sanity cost of 20.
messages.嫉妬の共鳴を作って撃ち、束縛を撒く。: Build Envy Resonance and fire it to spread Bind.
messages.充電人格では、解析Ⅲの充電返還(充電15消耗時)も活かせる。: With Charge Identities, the Charge refund at Threadspin Ⅲ (when spending 15 Charge) can also be used.
messages.侵蝕スキルは討伐時の充電獲得が目当てで、覚醒より使う機会は少ないと考えられる。: The Corrosion skill is mainly for gaining Charge on kills, and it likely sees less use than Awakening.
messages.Ⅲ: 火傷が2、ダメージ量の上限が30%になり、充電15消耗時に充電が5戻る。Ⅱ: **Ⅲ**: Burn becomes 2, the damage cap 30%, and 5 Charge is returned when spending 15. Coin Ⅱ also increases Charge.
messages.Ⅳ: 火傷が3、ダメージ量の上限が45%になり、チップの付与量が2になる。: **Ⅳ**: Burn becomes 3, the damage cap 45%, and Microchip infliction becomes 2.
messages.LCE E.G.O::AEDD: 充電を扱い、S3・守備が嫉妬で共鳴を作りやすい: **[LCE E.G.O:: AEDD](persona:1215)**: Uses Charge, and his S3 and Defense skill are Envy, making Resonance easy to build.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::ランプ: S1が憤怒で必要資源を出し、火傷を付与できる。: **[Lobotomy E.G.O::Lamp](persona:1214)**: His S1 is Wrath, supplying the required affinity, and he can inflict Burn.
